remarks: Rarely do you find an investment opportunity in Long Beach that offers this much versatility and such an incredible abundance of parking. Located at 219 Siena Drive, this unique triplex is a dream for any savvy investor or someone looking for a multi-unit property that truly checks every box. The property consists of three distinct units, each designed with attention to detail and very nicely presented. The layout features a spacious 2-bedroom unit, a flexible 1.5-bedroom unit, and a cozy 1-bedroom unit.
